text.tspan: Measures 70–75: Sequential passage related to measures 12–16, now in a different harmonic region.
Practice 70–71, 72–73, and 74–75; compare the fingering and voice-leading directly with measures 12–16.
Measures 76–82: Consolidation and cadence in C minor.
Practice 76–78 and 79–82; then isolate 82→83 so the cadence does not become an artificial stopping point.
Measures 83–94: New developmental arpeggios with increasingly chromatic harmonic motion.
Practice 83–86, 87–90, and 91–94, then reconnect the three groups while naming or hearing the underlying harmonies.
Measures 95–107: Intensifying harmonic development and rapid tonal reorientation.
Practice 95–98, 99–102, and 103–107; use slow harmonic practice rather than relying only on finger memory.
